Strategy: Maximize residual diversity. Different sizes cover different future items, so prefer creating a new size while spending a duplicated one, and avoid destroying the last bin of a size. Score by leftover: bonus for a novel leftover, penalty for a unique residual, so ranking can switch from Best Fit when it would erase a size or miss creating one. It may help by keeping many sizes available, but may fail by overvaluing sizes future items never need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if sum([1 for s in bins if s == r - item]) == 0 else 0) - (item if sum([1 for s in bins if s == r]) == 1 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Residual diversity: bonus for novel leftover size, penalty for using a unique residual.
